## Q. Omikuji doesn't respond to comments

- If OneComme is not receiving comments, omikuji won't respond either.
	- For details, see OneComme's official [Q. Comments aren't displaying properly](https://onecomme.com/docs/faq#%E3%82%B3%E3%83%A1%E3%83%B3%E3%83%88%E9%96%A2%E9%80%A3).
- **We recommend testing before you go live.**
	- You can check how omikuji behaves with OneComme's "Comment Tester" feature.
